groupings.title: Shopping · 筛电购物
groupings.description: 筛电 Filtmall 官方购物 Skill：面向中国电商的高性价比商品搜索、预算筛选、商品推荐、同款同规格比价与购买。China e-commerce shopping: product search, budget filtering, value-for-money recommendations, evidence-backed price comparison, checkout and order tracking. Current catalog: beauty and personal care.
